We report methylammonium lead iodide (MAPbI3) perovskite solar cells (PSCs) that reach a certified power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 21.1% under 1-sun AM1.5G illumination at initial scan.
We report methylammonium lead iodide (MAPbI3) perovskite solar cells (PSCs) that reach a certified power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 21.1% under 1-sun AM1.5G illumination at initial scan.
We examine the damp-heat stability of MAPbI3 perovskite solar cells and find that encapsulated devices retain a PCE of 18.7% after 500 h of aging at 85 °C and 85% relative humidity.
X-ray diffraction (XRD) confirmed a phase-pure tetragonal MAPbI3 film with no detectable PbI2 residue.
XRD patterns recorded after aging show the emergence of PbI2 peaks, indicating partial decomposition of the MAPbI3 absorber.
